support.title: Customer Support
support.subtitle: Help, questions, and emergencies — for every FELIX user.
support.tagline: Our greatest feature: directly contacting the CEO & developer for emergencies.
support.emergencyNote: This line reaches the CEO & developer directly. For emergencies it is answered at any hour; for everything else you will hear back the same day.
support.aboutBody: FELIX is a licensed showroom management platform covering inventory, CRM, deal approvals, contracts, finance and reporting. Your showroom's data is isolated end-to-end and every financial action is recorded in an append-only audit log.

inventory.title: Inventory & Asset Lifecycle
inventory.pricesHint: The sticker price is what the shop asks; the lowest offer is the least it will accept. Leave a field blank to clear it.
inventory.vinInvalid: A VIN is 17 letters or digits (no I, O or Q) — leave it empty if the car has none
inventory.featuresHint: The amenities list printed on the CPA windshield sticker — one feature per line.
inventory.itemCodeHint: The EGS or GS1 code registered on the ETA portal for this vehicle class.
inventory.purchaseHint: The showroom buys the car and owns it. Cost and equity apply.
inventory.consignmentHint: The car stays the owner's; the showroom sells it for a commission. No capital, no cost, no equity split.
inventory.commissionHint: What the showroom keeps when the car sells. The rest is owed back to the consignor and appears on the Accountant Hub.
inventory.commissionRequired: Set the commission type and value for a consignment
inventory.consignorNameRequired: A consignment needs the consignor's name
inventory.consignmentNoTerms: No commission terms were recorded for this car. Unless they are added, the whole sale price will be owed to the consignor.
inventory.consignmentExpenseHint: This car is on consignment. Money spent on it comes out of the showroom's commission — there is no shared profit pool on a car the showroom does not own.
inventory.acquisitionSourcePlaceholder: e.g. Cairo auction, trade-in referral, fleet company

interest.buyersSubtitle: Leads linked to this car, best offer first

deals.title: Deal Approval & Contract Vault
deals.inHouseInstallmentsHint: No bank. The showroom finances this sale itself; after execution, the payment plan and cheques are managed on the ticket.
deals.cashSettlementWarning: Cash settlement of vehicle sales is restricted under Egyptian payment regulations — car sales are expected to settle through bank channels. The cash settlement will be recorded on this ticket.
deals.etaSubtitle: Egyptian Tax Authority linkage for this sale
deals.etaNotSubmitted: Not yet submitted to the ETA portal.
deals.etaHint: Submit the invoice on the ETA portal, then transcribe the identifiers it issues here.
deals.tradeInHint: The buyer's old car, allowed against the price. It enters stock automatically the moment the sale is executed.
deals.tradeInNeedsCar: Enter the make and model of the trade-in car before allowing anything against it.
deals.tradeInStockNotFound: The trade-in car entered stock, but is not visible from here.
deals.consignmentBannerHint: The showroom does not own this car, so there is no profit waterfall. It earns a commission and owes the rest back.
deals.consignmentNoTerms: No commission terms were recorded for this car, so the whole sale price is owed to the consignor.
deals.etaSubmitTitle: Submit this invoice to the ETA
deals.etaSandboxNote: nothing is filed with the tax authority
deals.etaSandboxWarning: Sandbox mode. This document will NOT be filed with the Egyptian Tax Authority — the identifiers issued are simulated and have no legal standing.
deals.etaAlreadySubmitted: This sale already has a submission in progress or accepted. A new one is only allowed after a rejection or a failure.
deals.etaSubmittedPending: Sent — the authority has not answered yet. Reload to check again.
deals.etaIssueTicketNotExecuted: The sale has not been executed yet.
deals.etaIssueMissingContract: This deal has no contract yet — it must be approved first.
deals.etaIssueMissingVatFields: The VAT rate, amount and treatment must all be recorded on the deal.
deals.etaIssueNonPositivePrice: The agreed price must be greater than zero.
deals.etaIssueMissingIssuerRin: This branch has no VAT registration number recorded.
deals.etaIssueMissingIssuerAddress: The seller's address is not configured for e-invoicing.
deals.etaIssueMissingBuyerId: The buyer's national ID is required on any invoice of EGP 25,000 or more.
deals.etaIssueMissingBuyerIdWarn: The buyer has no national ID recorded.
deals.etaIssuePlaceholderItemCode: This vehicle has no registered ETA item code — a marked placeholder will be used.
deals.etaIssueVatAmountMismatch: The VAT recorded on the deal does not match the rate; the invoice will state the computed amount.
deals.etaIssueZeroVatRate: The VAT rate on this deal is zero.
deals.etaIssueMissingBuyerAddress: The buyer is a registered business with no address recorded.
deals.etaIssueMissingIssuerBranchCode: No ETA branch code is configured; head office (0) will be used.
deals.etaIssueSandboxIssuerAddress: The seller's address is a sandbox placeholder.

contractDoc.title: Vehicle Sale Contract
contractDoc.clauseAgreement: The Seller agrees to sell and the Buyer agrees to purchase the vehicle described above, for the final price stated, under the terms recorded in this contract.
contractDoc.clauseCondition: The Buyer confirms having inspected the vehicle and accepts it in its current condition. Any warranty is limited to what is stated in writing in this contract or its annexes.
contractDoc.clauseTitle: Ownership of the vehicle transfers to the Buyer only upon settlement of the full final price, or upon activation of the financing agreement named above.
contractDoc.footer: Contract {serial} — generated by FELIX Showroom Management. Valid only with both signatures.

reportDoc.vatRegistrationMissing: Not recorded — add each branch's tax registration number before filing.
reportDoc.netVatHint: Output tax minus input tax over the period — the net position carried onto Form 10.

reportDoc.noVatExpenses: No expenses with VAT recorded in this period.

receivables.title: In-house instalments
receivables.subtitle: The showroom's own book — the buyer owes us, not a bank
receivables.notExecuted: The payment plan is opened once the sale has been executed.
receivables.noPlan: No payment plan on this deal yet.
receivables.principalHint: The agreed price after the down payment. This is what the schedule is built on.
receivables.rateHint: A FLAT annual rate, the way showrooms quote it: interest is charged once on the whole amount for the whole term. Leave it empty for an interest-free plan.
receivables.ownershipRetained: Ownership stays with the showroom until settlement
receivables.ownershipRetainedNote: The ownership papers are transferred once the last instalment is paid.
receivables.previewUnavailable: Fill in the amount, term and start date to see the schedule.
receivables.noSchedule: This plan has no schedule yet — save it again to build one.
receivables.outstandingHint: Outstanding on this plan: {amount}. A payment cannot exceed it.
receivables.allocationHint: The payment is applied to the oldest unpaid instalment first, and split across instalments where it needs to be.
receivables.chequesSubtitle: The post-dated cheques held as security for this deal
receivables.noCheques: No cheques recorded against this deal.
receivables.drawerHint: Whose cheque book it is — often a relative or a company, and the name the bank will pursue.
receivables.receiptsSubtitle: Money taken at the counter against this deal
receivables.hubSubtitle: What the showroom is owed on its own instalment plans
receivables.agingHint: An instalment due today counts as not yet due. Ages are counted from the due date.
receivables.chequeCalendarSubtitle: What falls due over the next 30 days, by week
receivables.noUpcomingCheques: No cheques falling due in the next 30 days.

attendance.noDevices: No phones confirmed yet. The first punch from a phone will ask you to confirm it.
attendance.historySubtitle: Days with no punches are shown too.

attendance.adjustReasonPlaceholder: Phone battery flat — confirmed arrival in person

attendance.mapNeedsPin: Set a latitude and longitude to see the map.
attendance.geofenceNote: Attendance is never blocked. A punch from outside this area is still recorded, and shown to you as outside.
attendance.noBranchBody: Your account is not assigned to a branch, so there is nowhere to record attendance yet. Ask your manager.
